'''Bickell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3638 BBY]] Bickell participated in the [[Korriban Incursion]] along with [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Jensyn]], but he and his men left Jensyn in the [[Dark Council Chambers]] and started to pull out after the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] was taken and their objective completed. However, they learned that the Empire launched an [[Assault on Tython]] at the very same time and Bickell and his men were immediately redeployed to a new battlefield, assisting in retaking the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="TOR" />
